turns.report: Fixed unique_jobs to deduplicate rows by stable first occurrence based on (source, source_id) while preserving original rows and not merging across sources or by title. Missing/None/empty source_id keeps the row separately. Original implementation only deduplicated by title, which was incorrect. Implemented stable deduplication using a set to track seen (source, source_id) pairs and appending the first occurrence of each unique pair to the result. The original input rows were not mutated by using row.copy() before appending.
